subject: Coffee in Austin - perception model accuracy
text:
Hi [NAME],

I was in touch with Vib early this year - sounds like improving annotation
quality with a lean team was how he was thinking about perception model
accuracy. Given your role leading this team at [COMPANY] - I'd love to get
your perspectives on this.

We're familiar with the challenges of ensuring label quality across camera,
LiDAR and radar data. We recently helped Zipline consolidate 2D and 3D
annotation pipelines in one place with better autolabelling capabilities to
solve this. Happy to also share how we work with ML teams in defense
environments like Maxar.

It'd be great to chat over a coffee. We'll be in Austin Wed (11/19) to
Thurs (11/20) next week - happy to swing by your office or meet at a coffee
shop somewhere nearby?

subject: Large scale SKU catalogues workaround
text:
HI [NAME],

We recently onboarded Augmodo, and it made me think of [COMPANY]. We worked
with their CV team who were running large SKU catalogues and heavy video
pipelines, interested to know if this a challenge for [COMPANY] too?

A common theme we find for autonomous checkout CV teams is scaling
annotation and post-deployment updates without replacing their existing
catalogue tools. Encord's video-native tracking and lightweight
model-in-the-loop workflows have helped teams cut labelling time, speed up
store rollouts, and keep retraining cycles tight while keeping their
current systems in place.

Thought it might be useful to compare notes on what we're seeing in the
market and whether this could support [COMPANY] as you scale.

If you're open to a quick chat, next Thursday works well for me.

-[SENDER]

subject: Large SKU catalogues workaround
text:
Hi [NAME],

We've been working with several retail CV teams (most recently Augmodo) who
run large SKU catalogues and ingest millions of frames a day. The common
pain we're seeing is:

   - slow annotation throughput,
   - inefficient frame-by-frame workflows
   - difficulty connecting catalogue systems to labelling

Most have adopted Encord for two things:

   1. video-native tracking to massively increase frames labelled per action
   2. SDK integration so they can plug in their own models, trigger
   tracking flows, and tie annotations directly to their existing catalogue
   tools (without replacing them)

If you're facing something similar at [COMPANY], happy to share more. I'm free
next Thursday if that works.
